properties.name: ROFRAssets
properties.label: Select assets to be subject to a Right of First Refusal:

properties.name: ROFRLapseTF
properties.label: Do you wish to grant successive Rights of First Refusal if the first recipient predeceases or fails to timely exercise the option?
properties.helpText: The ROFR will lapse and the asset distributed to the Residuary Beneficiaries if successive rights are not be granted.

properties.options: [{"Name":"Buy","Description":"Purchase item for fair market value,"},{"Name":"Credit","Description":"Receive as as a credit toward residuary distribution."}]
properties.name: ResiduaryRefuseOption
properties.label: Select an option below:

properties.options: [{"Name":"Client","Description":"Client, if Client is the first Settlor to die"},{"Name":"Spouse","Description":"Spouse, if Spouse is the first Settlor to die"},{"Name":"Settlors","Description":"Upon the death of the last Settlor to die"}]
properties.optionTemplate: {[this == "Client" ? (Client.NameCO + "'s death") : this == "Spouse" ? (Spouse.NameCO + "'s death") : this == "Settlors" ? ("Upon the death of the last of " + Client.NameCO + " and " + Spouse.NameCO + " to die") : null]}
properties.name: SpecificUponDeath
properties.label: Select when this ROFR should be given:

properties.name: ROFRPortionTF
properties.label: Select to allow the holder to excercise the right of first refusal over less than the entire property.
properties.helpText: Selecting this option will allow the holder to exercise the right of first refusal over a portion of the asset and not the entire asset subject to the right of first refusal. The holder can pick and choose which asset or which portion of an assets (such as real estate) to purchase or accept as a credit toward their inheritance.
